text: The Government Flood Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives in Brunei Darussalam (2020–2025) aim to protect communities and critical assets from frequent and intense monsoon-driven rainfall. The program includes structural flood mitigation measures such as retention ponds, river dredging and widening, drainage upgrades, water control gates, and pumping systems. These initiatives are part of Brunei's National Development Plans and are led by the Ministry of Development and the Public Works Department, with oversight from the Legislative Council.
